title: Results Section Audit
subject: evidence-scope audit of a synthetic optimizer results excerpt
eyebrow: Generic IEEE/ACM engineering conventions · venue target not supplied
summary: The excerpt reports 12 solver-log outcomes, including three time-limited feasible incumbents with nonzero final gaps. Those logs do not support the universal global-optimum and 10-second guarantee, and the supplied record contains no deployment experiment or timing evidence beyond the logs to support real-time deployment readiness.
footer: Generated on 4 August 2026 by applying the checked-in repository-local ieee-acm-paper-writing skill. The HTML is a presentation of the canonical text audit and adds no scientific finding.

findings.title: Universal global-optimum and 10-second claim is contradicted by the logs
findings.source: The optimizer always returns the global optimum within 10 s.
findings.evidence: The supplied logs state that 3 of 12 runs reached the 60 s time limit with feasible incumbents and final gaps of 4.1%, 5.3%, and 7.8%. No exact-optimality certificate is supplied for those runs.
findings.consequence: The sentence asserts both a universal optimality guarantee and a 10 s termination bound that the reported outcomes directly fail to establish.
findings.correction: Remove the guarantee. Report the finite observed outcomes instead: 9 of 12 runs had solver status OPTIMAL under a 1% relative MIP-gap tolerance, while 3 reached the 60 s limit with feasible incumbents and the stated nonzero final gaps. Do not call the time-limited runs globally optimal.

findings.title: Real-time deployment readiness is unsupported
findings.source: The method is therefore ready for real-time deployment.
findings.evidence: No deployment experiment, operational validation, or timing measurements outside the supplied solver logs are provided. The logs include three runs that reached the 60 s time limit, and the excerpt does not establish a real-time budget or deployment conditions.
findings.consequence: The conclusion extends a bounded solver-log observation to deployment readiness without evidence for the required operating regime.
findings.correction: Remove the deployment-readiness statement. Retain only the scoped solver-log report. A deployment claim requires an explicitly defined real-time budget and a deployment or operational validation experiment with measurements under that regime.
